title: Książ southern side wing
visualBrief: Pale yellow elongated side wing:lower central range with repeated dormers and raised two-floor end pavilions beneath red tile roofs.

nativeAxes.origin: Mapped building envelope center. The reference approach sets the model elevation.

sourceFacts.primaryDescription: The hotel operator identifies three palace annexes;official heritage designation includes entrance buildings. This fourth nearby mapped Hotel Zamkowy is separately identified,with its role in the designated ensemble unconfirmed.

reconstruction.basis: Own attributed map footprint;two levels for gatehouse/side wings;mansard tags for side wings. Photographs guide visible composition,not exact dimensions.
reconstruction.scope: One independent entrance component of ksiaz_castle_and_park_complex. This does not complete the entire castle/park ensemble.
reconstruction.registration: The signed mapped ring and facing match the aerial and courtyard photographs. The standard retained Protomaps and Terrarium PMTiles locate the building and set an uncovered 398.98 m terrain contact. An inset sandstone footing follows the perimeter at the visualization datum. Three stone treads and a shallow apron join the recessed courtyard-side doorway to the original ground.
